clue.text: He falls behind to pull a girl back

indicators.note: back tells us to read the pulling word and the girl word together from right to left

parts.note: to drag is to pull
gal is an informal word for a girl

explanation.surface: A man trails behind so he can tug a young woman back towards him.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns the whole of DRAG + GAL, giving the answer read right to left.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who lags is slow and gets left at the rear, so a dawdler is one who falls behind.

clue.text: State of oil in USA? a haphazard arrangement

indicators.note: a haphazard arrangement says the letters of oil in USA and a are put in random order

explanation.surface: Asks whether a US state's oil industry is just a muddle.
explanation.definitionFit: The southern US territory on the Gulf of Mexico is one of the fifty states.

clue.text: Joke you're heard to make in conciliatory action?

indicators.note: heard says the words joke you're are turned into their spoken sound

parts.note: jest means joke, so jest you're is spoken

explanation.surface: Someone is told they were overheard joking during peace talks.
explanation.definitionFit: A goodwill move such as an olive branch is a sign or token act meant to conciliate.

clue.text: It may be inanimate, but a French one bears fruit

indicators.note: bears means the French word carries the fruit within it

parts.note: un is French for one
a tomato is a fruit

explanation.surface: Something lifeless, yet a Frenchman carries produce.
explanation.definitionFit: A robot moves by itself yet has no life, so it may be called inanimate.

clue.text: Distribute timber in Kent

explanation.surface: Handing out wood somewhere in south-east England.
explanation.walkthrough: Three definitions: to hand out cards, pine or fir wood, and a seaside town in Kent, a county of south-east England.
explanation.definitionFit: To share out cards is to distribute them; pine planks are softwood timber; and the coastal resort is a town in Kent.

clue.text: Jazz fan holding nude entertainment in restaurant

indicators.note: holding means the jazz-fan word wraps round the word for nude

parts.note: a cat is old slang for a jazz enthusiast
nude means bare

explanation.surface: A jazz lover takes in a naked floor show while dining out.
explanation.definitionFit: A floor show of songs and dancing put on while diners eat is the classic nightclub form of entertainment.

clue.text: Beetle irritating to Chanticleer

parts.note: Chanticleer is the cockerel of fable and Chaucer
a chafer is something that rubs and irritates, used here loosely for irritating

explanation.surface: An insect that annoys the farmyard rooster.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as 'something chafing a cock', the beetle's name splits into two words.
explanation.definitionFit: The large brown maybug is a kind of beetle.

clue.text: Gamble about engineer's hat

indicators.note: about means the gamble word goes round the engineers' letters

parts.note: a bet is a gamble
RE stands for the Royal Engineers, a British Army corps

explanation.surface: A wager on what an engineer wears on his head.
explanation.definitionFit: A flat round soft cap is a type of hat.

clue.text: A barrier to such abuse?

explanation.surface: Asks whether a fence keeps out a particular kind of insult.
explanation.definitionFit: A fence of bars is a barrier, and ranting at someone is a form of verbal abuse.

clue.text: Fish in ditch, not river

indicators.note: not means the river letter is left out of the ditch word

parts.note: a trench is a ditch

explanation.surface: A fish found in a ditch rather than a river.
explanation.definitionFit: The freshwater carp-family species found in ponds is a kind of fish.

clue.text: Discompose a clique in Uttar Pradesh

parts.note: UP is the standard abbreviation for the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh
a set is a clique or circle of people

explanation.surface: Ruffling the feathers of a social circle somewhere in northern India.
explanation.definitionFit: To discompose someone is to unsettle or disturb their calm, a straight synonym.

clue.text: Agreement one has about a musical instrument

parts.note: an accord is an agreement
I is the Roman numeral for one
on means about, concerning, as in a talk on a subject

explanation.surface: A pact someone holds concerning a musical instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: A squeezebox with bellows and keys is a well-known example of a musical instrument.

clue.text: Like the worst part of a dirty film

explanation.surface: A sniffy verdict on the lowest moment of a smutty movie.
explanation.definitionFit: Scum is the dregs, the lowest of the low, and also the grimy layer that forms on top of a liquid; the adjective covers both senses.

clue.text: Tax this novel, like "Redgauntlet"?

parts.note: scot is an old word for a tax, as in scot-free

indicators.note: novel means new or fresh, so the letters of this are made into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Someone is told to levy a duty on a particular book, a Walter Scott romance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'novel' rearranges THIS into TISH after SCOT. Redgauntlet is a novel by Sir Walter Scott set in Scotland, so 'novel' looks like the definition's subject but is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Redgauntlet is set in Scotland and written by a Scots author, so it is a work of that nation's literature.

clue.text: He's the examiner who counts when it comes to a vote

definitions.text: He's the examiner who counts when it comes to a vote

parts.words: He's the examiner who counts when it comes to a vote
parts.note: counts means both matters and tallies: the official who checks ballot papers in an election

explanation.surface: Describes the person who really matters in an election.
explanation.definitionFit: This official inspects and tallies ballot papers at an election, so he examines and counts votes.

clue.text: Skilled performer inclined to keep notes

indicators.note: to keep means the word for inclined holds the notes inside it

parts.note: apt means inclined, likely to
D and E are two musical notes

explanation.surface: A gifted musician tends to hang on to the sheet music.
explanation.definitionFit: An expert is a skilled hand, so someone highly proficient is a skilled performer.

clue.text: Feigned anguish, say, at the celebration?

indicators.note: say signals that the words for feigned anguish are spoken and only sound like the answer

parts.note: sham pain is pretended suffering

explanation.surface: Someone puts on a show of distress at a party.
explanation.definitionFit: The fizzy wine is so closely linked with festivities that it stands for a celebration, hence the question mark.

clue.text: A handy way of predicting the future

definitions.text: A handy way of predicting the future

parts.words: A handy way of predicting the future
parts.note: handy here means done by hand: fortune-telling from the lines on the hand

explanation.surface: Praise for a convenient method of forecasting.
explanation.definitionFit: Fortune-telling from the lines on a hand is literally a way of foretelling events using the hand.

clue.text: Delighted to sing when in need, perhaps

indicators.note: in places the singing word inside the rearranged letters of need
perhaps says the letters of need may be arranged another way

parts.note: to chant is to sing

explanation.surface: Someone happy to sing when times are hard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' rearranges NEED as EN...ED, and 'in' puts CHANT inside.
explanation.definitionFit: To be charmed or thrilled is to be delighted, so the two are synonyms.

clue.text: Exciting experience coming to a river

parts.note: an advent is a coming or arrival
the Ure is a river in Yorkshire

explanation.surface: A thrill felt on arriving at a riverbank.
explanation.definitionFit: An escapade is an exciting or daring experience, so the two match as synonyms.

clue.text: Scoundrel appears to be purposelessly bad'

annotationWithheld.why: Scoundrel appears to be purposelessly bad: ILL in VAIN, but 'purposelessly' must give both VAIN and the containment 'in', one word doing two jobs
annotationWithheld.clue: Scoundrel appears to be purposelessly bad'

clue.text: See soldier about Kantian philosophy

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning see or behold
GI is an American soldier
c, short for circa, means about

explanation.surface: A trooper is consulted on the ideas of Immanuel Kant.
explanation.definitionFit: The study of reasoning is a branch of philosophy, and Kant wrote a major treatise on transcendental reasoning.

clue.text: Unusual vessel for many in lagoon, possibly

indicators.note: in places the letter for many inside the rearranged lagoon
possibly says the letters of lagoon might be rearranged

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500, used for many

explanation.surface: An odd boat for crowds on a lagoon, perhaps in Venice.
explanation.definitionFit: The Venetian canal boat is a distinctive and unusual kind of vessel.

clue.text: Missile featuring as part of newscast

parts.note: a bullet is a missile
in means featuring as part of, as an actor is in a film

explanation.surface: A rocket attack is reported as an item on the evening news.
explanation.definitionFit: A short broadcast summary of the news is a newscast.

clue.text: Twigs what one means by "broom"

parts.note: twigs reads as understands, but it is the material: a bundle of sticks that one means by a broom

explanation.surface: Someone grasps what is meant by the word broom.
explanation.definitionFit: This old-fashioned sweeping brush is made from a bundle of twigs tied to a handle.

clue.text: Leave former wife to have a meal

parts.note: an ex is a former wife
to eat is to have a meal

explanation.surface: Someone leaves the ex-wife to go and dine.
explanation.definitionFit: This Latin-derived term is formal permission for a pupil or student to be absent, a leave of absence.

clue.text: Zambian leader in Islington area with a plant

indicators.note: the leader of the word Zambian is its opening letter

parts.note: N1 is the postcode district covering Islington in London, read here as the letters N and I

explanation.surface: An African chief sits in a north London district with a pot plant.
explanation.walkthrough: N1 is a London postcode for Islington; the figure 1 is read as the letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: The bright daisy-like garden flower named after Johann Zinn is a kind of plant.

clue.text: Pack in point-to-point

parts.note: S, south, is a compass point
W, west, is another compass point

explanation.surface: Loading up for a point-to-point, a British amateur steeplechase.
explanation.definitionFit: To stow luggage is to pack it away.

clue.text: Declaration of condition intended to be heard

parts.note: state means condition

indicators.note: to be heard means the word for intended is spoken and only its sound is entered

parts.note: meant means intended

explanation.surface: An announcement about someone's health, meant to be listened to.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal declaration is something stated publicly, so they are synonyms.

clue.text: Common old woman, but uncommon tutor

indicators.note: uncommon means unusual, so the letters of tutor are put in an unusual order

explanation.surface: A vulgar old lady is set beside an exceptional teacher.
explanation.definitionFit: Old trout is a common, colloquial and unflattering term for an old woman.

clue.text: Way to address a man outside northern church?

indicators.note: outside means the polite title goes round the letter for northern

parts.note: mister is how one addresses a man

explanation.surface: Asks how to greet a man standing outside a church in the north.
explanation.definitionFit: A large or important church, such as York's, often one that began as a monastery, is called this.

clue.text: Capricious course Artemus followed

indicators.note: followed puts the humorist's surname after the word for course

parts.note: a way is a course or route
Artemus Ward was the pen name of the American humorist Charles Farrar Browne

explanation.surface: A fickle route that the humorist Artemus took.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone wilful and unpredictable is capricious, so the two are synonyms.
